A '''tulrus sword''' was, as its name suggested, a type of two-handed [[Sword/Legends|sword]] that was made from the body of a [[Tulrus/Legends|tulrus]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. They appeared to be constructed from one of the many spikes that protruded from the creature's body. Despite their size, the swords were known to be well balanced, as if they had been made out of a lighter material.

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tulrus swords appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
